input_rationale.evolution: The executor boundary and rank-local broadcast rule are additive and focused, but do not yet have upstream maintenance history.
input_rationale.locality: The change stays within configuration validation, executor ownership, focused rollout tests, and matching documentation/evidence.
input_rationale.tests: The local suite, focused two-rank NCCL tests, six-rank lifecycle and GRPO tests, five fresh six-rank replays, and the L20 non-extension regression suite passed.
input_rationale.failure: Non-DDP multiprocess rollout, distributed FSDP, and torch.compile combinations fail before unsupported scheduler execution.
input_rationale.contract: Source, tests, workload, deployment cell, and acceptance criteria are digest-bound, but the artifact is not sealed or maintainer-reviewed.
input_rationale.integration: TrainContextBuilder obtains the inference model through its executor while retaining the wrapped DDP model for synchronized training.
input_rationale.interface: The executor-owned model_for_inference API preserves existing single-device behavior and exposes DDP.module only for replicated DDP.
input_rationale.lifecycle: Ranks may perform different counts of collective-free rollout forwards, then safely resume wrapped DDP forward/backward/update and invalidate stale KV state.
input_rationale.buildtest: Python and torch-native regression paths pass; the source-mounted cu128 runtime image lacked nvcc and could not rebuild native extensions.
input_rationale.policy: Six zero-compute L20s were used after an explicitly authorized release of their inference contexts; the active training jobs on GPU2 and GPU7 were left untouched, and unsupported modes remain explicit.
input_rationale.attainment: The correctness target passed: divergent per-rank rollout forwards complete without deadlock and the next DDP update leaves changed, bitwise-identical replicas.
input_rationale.coverage: Coverage includes CPU/Gloo state broadcast, two-rank focused checks, a six-rank NCCL DDP lifecycle probe, a real six-rank online GRPO Trainer job, five replays, and negative configuration contracts.
input_rationale.retention: The local suite and the complete non-extension L20 regression suite passed after the change.
input_rationale.family: The executor boundary is shared by online GRPO and online DPO, while the end-to-end multirank workload specifically exercises GRPO.
input_rationale.compile: torch.compile is explicitly rejected for online rollout, and native extension rebuild evidence was unavailable in the runtime-only L20 image.
input_rationale.replay: Five independent fresh pytest processes passed the six-rank online GRPO workload.
input_rationale.load: Each replay ran a real six-rank Trainer job for seven optimizer steps per rank with rollout refresh every step and produced epoch_0_step_7.
input_rationale.resource: Only GPU0, GPU1, GPU3, GPU4, GPU5, and GPU6 were exposed; the active training workloads on GPU2 and GPU7 were not touched.
input_rationale.coldsteady: Five independent six-rank processes provide cold-start-inclusive stability data, and the workload also passed inside the broader six-rank regression run.
